description: Differentiates 1-year rolling forecasts (t+1) from multi-year recursive forecasts (t+2, t+3). In multi-year forecasts, earlier predictions are fed back into lag features, compounding error.

horizon_3_year_recursive.input_features: 1-year & 2-year recursive predictions fed into lag_1 & lag_2

error_compounding_summary: MAE compounds from 1.638m at 1-year lead time to 1.749m at 2-year lead time and 1.740m at 3-year lead time.
